scope: FIFA men's international match calendar (club release windows) and the tournaments that remove players, for the seasons a career simulates. Dates are a window's or tournament's first and last day, not travel days.

field_notes.precision: 'day' = both dates stated by a source; 'month' = only the month (or a month range) is published, so start/end stay null.
field_notes.pauses_club_football: true = the domestic leagues concerned stop playing for the whole tournament (either a mid-season pause, or the tournament fills a period that would otherwise hold fixtures); false = those leagues keep playing and only release players under FIFA rules; null = not established by a source.
field_notes.matches: number of matches each national team can play in the window (from the FIFA calendar table).

windows.label: June
windows.note: Reserved for pre-World Cup friendlies; squads were released earlier than the window (see auxiliary/club_release_world_cup_2026).

tournaments.name: Africa Cup of Nations 2025
tournaments.note: Started in December 2025 and ends in January 2026, so it blocks the first three weeks of the 2026 club year. Moved to the Christmas period to avoid the expanded FIFA Club World Cup, i.e. it deliberately sits inside the European and African league season.
tournaments.quote: Due to a scheduling conflict with the expanded 2025 FIFA Club World Cup in June and July, the Africa Cup of Nations was played between 21 December 2025 and 18 January 2026

tournaments.name: FIFA World Cup 2026
tournaments.note: 48 teams, 104 matches, 39 days. The club season for players in final squads ended on 24 May 2026 (see auxiliary).
tournaments.quote: The tournament began on June 11, 2026, and concluded on July 19

tournaments.name: CONCACAF Gold Cup 2027
tournaments.note: FIFA's own calendar table gives the Gold Cup slot as 19 June – 11 July 2027, the tournament article as 17 June – 11 July. Start date taken from the tournament article; diff the two if a fixture lands on 17–18 June. Displaces MLS fixtures (MLS runs Feb–Nov); Liga MX is between seasons.
tournaments.quote: The tournament will take place from June 17 to July 11, 2027.

tournaments.name: Africa Cup of Nations 2027
tournaments.note: June–July is the European off-season, so European leagues lose no fixtures. African leagues in the CECAFA region are also between seasons; leagues on a Feb–Nov calendar lose players instead.
tournaments.quote: It will be hosted by Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania from 19 June to 17 July 2027.

tournaments.name: AFC Asian Cup 2027
tournaments.note: Postponed on 3 November 2026 from 7 January – 5 February 2027 to this slot, so it now runs mid-season for AFC leagues and over the European winter. Spills into 2028; also listed there.
tournaments.quote: the tournament was postponed to start from 23 December 2027 to 21 January 2028

windows.label: May–June
windows.note: Early slot because the June–July period is taken by the confederation finals (Euro, Copa América, AFCON, OFC Nations Cup).

tournaments.name: AFC Asian Cup 2027 (final stage)
tournaments.note: Repeated from 2027 so a 2028 schedule generator blocks 1–21 January without reading the previous year.
tournaments.quote: the tournament was postponed to start from 23 December 2027 to 21 January 2028

tournaments.name: UEFA Euro 2028
tournaments.host: England, Scotland, Wales, Republic of Ireland
tournaments.note: 24 teams, 51 matches; opener in Cardiff 9 June, final at Wembley 9 July. European leagues are between seasons, so no fixtures are lost — the June window is simply gone.
tournaments.quote: will take place from 9 June to 9 July 2028

tournaments.name: Africa Cup of Nations 2028
tournaments.note: Provisional: host not chosen, and FIFA's calendar note says the edition may move to December 2028 – January 2029 depending on the host. Off-season for European leagues.

tournaments.name: Copa América 2028
tournaments.note: Only 'June – July 2028' is published (Wikipedia infobox; FIFA calendar table has the same month-level slot). CONMEBOL leagues on a calendar-year season (Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay) are in season, so those weeks are lost.

tournaments.name: Olympic men's football tournament 2028
tournaments.host: United States (Los Angeles and six other cities)
tournaments.note: U-23 plus three overage players; not a FIFA release window, so clubs are not obliged to release and leagues do not stop. Dates cover the whole Olympic football programme (men's and women's); the men's bracket alone is not separately published.
tournaments.quote: will be held in Los Angeles and six other cities in the United States from July 10 to 29, 2028

auxiliary.what: Clubs release World Cup players before the tournament, so the domestic season ends earlier than the 11 June start: last club matchday 24 May 2026, release by 25 May, with continental-final exceptions to 30 May.
auxiliary.quote: The final matchday at club level for players named in the final squads was May 24, 2026; clubs had to release their players by May 25, with exceptions granted to players participating in continental club competition finals up until May 30.

auxiliary.applies_to: every window and every confederation tournament (AFCON, Asian Cup, Gold Cup, Copa América) for clubs outside that confederation
auxiliary.what: A league outside the tournament's confederation does not stop; it loses the players. Official matches: 4-day release, 5 days if the match is on another continent; friendlies 48 hours.
auxiliary.quote: Official matches have a release period of four days, which means that players can take up to four days away from club duties to partake in national team duties. ... If a player participates in an official match on a different continent from their club's, the release period is five days. Friendly matches are deemed less important and the release period is 48 hours.

auxiliary.applies_to: 2027 AFC Asian Cup; the January 2027 slot in the FIFA table
auxiliary.what: The edition moved from 7 January – 5 February 2027 to 23 December 2027 – 21 January 2028 on 3 November 2026. The FIFA calendar table in its December 2025 revision still shows the old slot; the current table shows only the December 2027 row, i.e. there is no longer a January 2027 international window.
auxiliary.quote: Originally scheduled to be held in Saudi Arabia from 7 January to 5 February 2027 ... the tournament was postponed to start from 23 December 2027 to 21 January 2028 due to "exceptional circumstances"
auxiliary.derived_note: The disappearance of the January 2027 window is read off the difference between the two Wikipedia revisions of the calendar, not stated in one sentence.

auxiliary.what: No Copa América in 2027: the tournament is quadrennial (2024, then 2028). A 2027 calendar must not reserve a mid-year Copa slot.
auxiliary.quote: The 2028 Copa América will be the 49th edition of the Copa América ... Argentina are the two-time defending champions, having won their record 16th title in 2024 Copa América

auxiliary.what: FIFA's calendar note says the June–July 2028 AFCON slot may move to December 2028 – January 2029 depending on host selection, which would put it back mid-season.
auxiliary.quote: May be pushed back to December 2028 – January 2029 depending on host selection

auxiliary.what: Hosts: Canada, Mexico, United States; 16 venues in 16 host cities.
auxiliary.quote: It was jointly hosted by 16 cities—11 in the United States, 3 in Mexico, and 2 in Canada.
